assertions.text: Recognizes Report A and Report B describe the same underlying issue and collapses them into one entry citing both
Tags the merged finding explicitly to git-kit's merge-pr on the finding itself, not only via a source-report citation
Classifies severity via severity-vocabulary.md's mapping table (P2 -> Major)
Notes that Report C's finding (mining-recurring-patterns, no native severity term) needs the tier definitions applied directly per the stated fallback, rather than skipped
Does not silently drop or wrongly merge Report C's finding as a duplicate of A/B
